title: Gold after a large intraday reversal in silver, against the same-side every-day baseline

rule.event: silver runs >= 0.5 x ATR(20) beyond its previous close and closes on the other side of it
rule.side: gold traded the way silver closed
rule.costs: $0.60 a round trip + nights() x FIN.xau.long on buys

tests.what: all silver reversals, both sides, gold traded the way silver closed: excess net R over the same-side every-day baseline (primary)
silver reversals on days gold did not itself close the reversal way: excess net R
the T1 stream: raw net R
